Japanese knotweed (Reynoutria japonica, formerly Polygonum cuspidatum) extract is a vegetable extract, so it falls in heading 1302 (vegetable saps and extracts). Subheading 1302.19 covers "other" vegetable saps and extracts. The 1302.19 statistical lines are:
- 1302.19.05 (Capsicum oleoresin?) — not certain
- 1302.19.15 (medicinal, other)
- 1302.19.40 (other: ...)
- 1302.19.91 and similar lines

My recollection of the 1302.19 structure is as follows:
- 1302.19.05: Ginseng extracts?
- 1302.19.10: Medicinal?
- 1302.19.15: Mixtures
- 1302.19.20: Oleoresin
- 1302.19.30: Pyrethrum? 
- 1302.19.91: Other, of a kind used primarily in pharmacy
- 1302.19.4100: Other

The extract is an herbal tincture, so it is sold as a medicinal or herbal product. Because the tincture is dissolved in glycerin, I considered 3004 (medicaments in measured doses or retail packages), but the description gives no dosage or therapeutic indication. Heading 1302 remains the best fit.

For the statistical line, I chose 1302.19.9190, the other-extracts line, as a likely fit. I'm not fully certain of that suffix.
